title: Senior Auditor (Licensed CPA)
description:
Job Title: Senior Auditor

Location: Remote (Philippines, Central America/Latin America)

Working hours: Central Time Zone



About the Company:
We are a growing CPA firm in Texas managing over 3,000 clients annually across various segments (individuals, SMBs, and other business types). We pride ourselves on delivering quality audit and tax services while building a collaborative, supportive team culture.



About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced CPA with a strong audit background to join our accounting firm as a Senior Auditor. You will lead audit engagements from start to finish, supervise junior audit staff, and manage multiple client engagements across diverse industries. This is a hands-on role that requires ownership, independence, and a commitment to quality work.

In addition to strong audit expertise, this role requires a forward-thinking mindset. Our firm is actively implementing new technologies across audit, tax, and firm-wide operations. Candidates must be comfortable working in a tech-enabled environment and demonstrate either experience with modern tools or a strong willingness to learn and adopt them quickly.

We are currently using AI and automation tools across functions, including:

 - Audit: Claude, DataSnipper

 - Firm-wide: Claude, Karbon, AccountGroove

 - Tax: Liscio, Gruntworx, ProSeries, Claude.



Key Responsibilities:

 - Lead and manage audit engagements independently, taking ownership from initiation through completion

 - Supervise and mentor two junior audit staff members

 - Conduct audits for commercial and non-profit clients across various industries

 - Manage 15-20+ concurrent audit engagements, with workload fluctuating seasonally

 - Execute audit work using AuditFile and AuditSight software

 - Collaborate with internal tax team on integrated engagements

 - Conduct other related accounting work (e.g., tax)

 - Maintain regular communication with audit leadership (check-ins every other day)

 - Stay current with audit standards, best practices, and emerging technologies impacting audit workflows



Required Qualifications:

 - CPA license (active and in good standing)

 - Minimum 5+ years of audit experience with a mid-to-large accounting firm

 - Proven ability to lead audit engagements independently

 - Experience supervising junior staff

 - Strong understanding of audit methodologies across multiple industries

 - Proficiency with audit software (AuditFile or similar platforms preferred but not required)

 - Fluent in English

 - Strong adaptability and willingness to work in a technology-driven audit environment
   
   

Preferred Qualifications:

 - Experience in a mid-to-large accounting firm environment

 - US GAAP and IFRS experience is a plus

 - Interest or experience in AI tools, automation, or technology-enabled audit processes (e.g., Claude, DataSnipper, or similar tools)

 - Flexibility to support tax work during slower audit seasons

 - Experience managing diverse client bases

 - Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and implement new software tools in a professional setting
   

Key Competencies:

 - Ownership mentality and ethical standards

 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills

 - Ability to take constructive feedback and incorporate it

 - Comfortable working as part of a team with regular interaction across departments

 - Problem-solving and critical thinking

 - Adaptability to new tools, systems, and AI-driven workflows

 - Proactive interest in improving processes through technology adoption

title: Digital Ad Buyer
description:
Job Title: Digital Ad Buyer & Quality Control 

Location: Remote (Latin America) 

Work Hours: Full-Time 

Compensation: $2,500–$3,000 USD/month



About the Role

We are seeking a highly detailed and hands-on Digital Ad Buyer & Quality Control specialist to support our performance marketing team. Our client is a boutique digital marketing agency that prioritizes substance over fluff, maintaining a close, high-impact relationship with a limited roster of premium clients across music, entertainment, media, and tech.

This role is structured in phases: initially, your primary focus will be performing meticulous quality checks and reporting across paid marketing, email, and SMS campaigns. Within a month, you will transition into independently planning, setting up, and launching ad campaigns across multiple platforms. If you are an incredibly organized stickler for detail who loves a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.



Key Responsibilities

 - Quality Assurance: Quality check campaign execution by the advertising team, catching errors in setup, targeting, copy, creative, event dates, locations, and more.

 - Communications & Tracking: Monitor and respond to pertinent email communications between clients and external teams.

 - Campaign Execution: Build, launch, and manage end-to-end paid ad campaigns without assistance across Meta and TikTok (and ideally Google).

 - Strategy & Reporting: Create strategic and budget recommendations for campaigns and develop regular reports with actionable insights for clients.

 - Project Management: Ensure meeting action items are carefully noted, assigned, and tracked in ClickUp to ensure timely execution.



Must-Have Qualifications

 - Experience: 3+ years of experience building and managing ad campaigns, with deep expertise in the nuances of the Meta ads platform at a micro level, alongside experience in TikTok and Google Ads.

 - Project Management Tools: Proficiency using in-depth project management platforms such as ClickUp, Asana, or similar software.

 - Extreme Attention to Detail: Absolute zero-tolerance for typos, inaccurate information, or mismatched event details (such as dates, venues, or lineups).

 - Communication Skills: Proactive internal and external communication skills with fluent English proficiency.

 - Team Fit: Experience working closely with a small, fast-paced team while remaining highly organized with your own tasks, priorities, and calendar.



Nice-to-Have Qualifications

 - Experience working with ticketed live events, a passion for music, or strong taste in the space.

 - Hands-on technical experience with tracking pixels (generation, installation, conversion events, and custom audience creation).

 - Proficiency with Google Analytics to monitor client traffic trends.

 - Experience drafting and executing email or SMS marketing campaigns using platforms like Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Laylo, Hive, or Community.

 - Foundational SEO optimization skills across client web domains.



Why Work With Us?

 - Join a boutique, fast-paced team where your work directly moves the needle for high-quality clients.

 - Escape the corporate fluff—we focus on meaningful campaigns, proactive insights, and real results that keep clients partnering with us for years.

 - Opportunity to rapidly expand your operational responsibilities from quality control into full campaign ownership.

title: Digital Marketer (E-commerce)
description:
Job Title: Digital Marketer (E-commerce)

Job Type: Full-time, Remote

Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

Salary: USD $2,000 - $2,800 per month (depending on experience)

Location: Latin America (LATAM)




ABOUT THE COMPANY

Our client is a rapidly growing U.S.-based e-commerce eyewear company specializing in designer frames, prescription lenses, and premium optical products. Combining a strong customer-first approach with streamlined online operations, the company delivers high-quality eyewear solutions to customers across the United States and internationally. As the business continues to scale, they are looking for an experienced digital marketer who can help drive customer acquisition, retention, and long-term brand growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly experienced Digital Marketer with a strong background in e-commerce marketing, preferably within a small to mid-sized consumer brand. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands the entire digital marketing ecosystem and can confidently manage multiple initiatives with minimal supervision.

While email marketing through Klaviyo will be a major focus, this position also requires experience across website merchandising, social media, analytics, creative asset coordination, paid marketing, and emerging e-commerce channels such as TikTok Shop.

This is not an entry-level or training position. The ideal candidate should be comfortable stepping into an established business, understanding existing systems quickly, and contributing from day one without requiring extensive onboarding on marketing platforms or e-commerce best practices.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own and execute the company's email marketing strategy using Klaviyo, including campaigns, automations, customer segmentation, and lifecycle flows.

 - Create and optimize email sequences such as welcome series, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, win-back, and promotional campaigns.

 - Monitor campaign performance and continuously improve key metrics including revenue, conversion rate, click-through rate, customer retention, and ROI.

 - Manage and optimize the Shopify storefront, merchandising, and customer experience to improve conversion rates.

 - Support paid e-commerce marketing initiatives across Meta, Google, TikTok, and other digital advertising platforms.

 - Develop and coordinate social media marketing strategies across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.

 - Explore and support TikTok Shop opportunities and other emerging social commerce platforms.

 - Coordinate influencer and affiliate marketing initiatives.

 - Analyze website and marketing performance using Google Analytics and other reporting tools to identify growth opportunities.

 - Collaborate on creative assets including graphics, landing pages, promotional materials, and website updates.

 - Continuously identify, test, and scale new marketing channels and growth opportunities.




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Minimum of 3 years of hands-on digital marketing experience supporting e-commerce or direct-to-consumer brands.

 - Strong experience working within a small to mid-sized company where you managed multiple areas of marketing rather than a single specialty.

 - Expert-level experience with Klaviyo, including email campaigns, automation, segmentation, and customer lifecycle marketing.

 - Strong Shopify experience, including merchandising, promotions, and e-commerce workflows.

 - Experience managing paid digital marketing campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok, or similar platforms.

 - Strong understanding of Google Analytics and marketing performance reporting.

 - Experience supporting or creating content for social media marketing.

 - Comfortable coordinating graphic design work or creating marketing assets using design tools such as Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.

 - Strong understanding of customer acquisition, retention, conversion optimization, and e-commerce KPIs.

 - Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple marketing initiatives simultaneously.

 - Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

 - Able to work independently, prioritize effectively, and deliver results with minimal supervision.
   
   


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with TikTok Shop or other social commerce platforms.

 - Experience managing influencer or affiliate marketing programs.

 - Knowledge of conversion rate optimization (CRO) and website UX best practices.

 - Familiarity with Shopify themes, Liquid, or other technical marketing implementations.

 - Experience in fashion, eyewear, beauty, lifestyle, or other consumer product brands.

title: Email Marketing Specialist
description:
LIFECYCLE / EMAIL MARKETING MANAGER 

 - Type: Full-Time, Remote 

 - Working Hours: Mondays - Fridays, 9:00am - 5:00pm PST

 - Compensation: USD $ 1800 -2500 (based on experience and location)





ABOUT THE COMPANY: 

For over 35 years, we've transacted more than $3.5 billion of real estate, acquiring over 14,648 multifamily units and taking dozens of properties full cycle — on average returning 100% of investor capital plus strong returns. Our focus is acquiring older apartment home communities and creating value by improving the properties, optimizing operations, and fostering human flourishing in each one. Above all, we've learned that success is measured not just by financial gain, but by the quality of the relationships we build along the way. Please read our values https://wearewilkinson.com/about/real-estate-investment-group-values, and if you are aligned, we encourage you to apply. 

 


JOB OVERVIEW: 

We're a US-based investment firm running two brands — an SEC-regulated real-estate investment fund and a family-focused coaching and publishing brand. The Social Media & Community Manager is the maker who owns the social presence and community across both: the daily content cadence, the calendar, organic growth, and the health of every community segment. You execute under the EVP's creative direction and turn it into reels, posts, and stories that ship on schedule and grow a real, engaged audience. You make sure the online community is engaged and supported for both brands. This is a content-and-community operator role — fast, native to the platforms, aware of event promotion and testimonials, and high-output.

 

Success ties directly to revenue: keep the funnels, deliverability, and capture healthy— every lead captured, routed correctly, nurtured, and reachable.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the ESP and the email/SMS engine. Own ActiveCampaign end-to-end — lists, segments, automations, builds, CRM tagging, webhooks, and sends; own subscription lists, imports, and segmentation; run the SMS/text campaigns.

 - Build the nurture and lifecycle automation. Build drip and nurture sequences (e.g., the post-capital investor sequence); document which tags fire which sequences so the logic is legible and maintainable; build webinar and event registration and confirmation flows in Zoom, Calendly, and new tools as they come online.

 - Protect deliverability. Own domain authentication, DNS and seed-email setup, and inbox warmups (Inbox Ally), across several domains, so the brand earns and keeps inbox placement. This is the foundation everything else rests on: large email open rates exceeding 35% opens

 - Capture and route every lead. Edit and test the NFC digital-card / lead-capture system before each event; make sure capture-form consent options and checkboxes are present and correct; route captured event leads into the CRM and the right sequences; review new leads daily and trigger timely follow-up; confirm territories and define which lead goes to which rep and sequence for the Developer to build.


REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years in email marketing, marketing automation, lifecycle, or CRM — with hands-on ownership of an ESP (ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Klaviyo, Marketo, or similar).

 - Deliverability expertise. You manage SPF/DKIM/DMARC, DNS, warmups, and inbox placement, and you can diagnose why mail lands in spam. This is the specialized skill that makes or breaks the role.

 - Automation builder. You build drip, nurture, and behavioral sequences and keep the tag-to-sequence logic clean and documented.

 - Lead capture and routing. Forms, consent/compliance fields, event capture, territory routing, and CRM hygiene are second nature.

 - Owner's mindset: whatever-it-takes hours, low-ego, drives outcomes without being told.

 - Real AI & systems builder: you build automation, processes and segmentation workflows in Claude using connectors, agents, skills — that 2× your output. Not prompt-dabbling.

 - Self-sufficient operator: you know what to do and where to go unprompted and learn any tool cold.

 - Execution obsession: you test every sequence and flow end-to-end before it ships — nothing goes live broken.

 - Proactive communicator who drives the update cadence and never goes dark.

 - Valid passport and able to travel to the US up to 2× per year for ~one week (first trip Aug 31- Sep 3.).

 - Using Zoom and Calendly tools for transaction-based email sequences

 - Strong written and spoken English and a reliable remote setup.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with regulated or financial-services email — consent, disclosures, suppression management, and compliant SMS (TCPA-style opt-in).

 - ActiveCampaign and/or HubSpot certification or deep fluency; experience migrating or running both.

 - Text-based messaging oversight such as SalesMsg

 - Hands-on with deliverability tooling (Inbox Ally, Google Postmaster, seed-list testing).

 - Experience with event / field lead capture (NFC, Whova, registration flows).

 - Built AI-assisted lifecycle or segmentation systems before.

 - High-volume B2C, membership, or investor-nurture experience.

 - A methodical, detail-obsessed working style — the kind of person who notices a broken merge tag before it goes out to 10,000 people

title: Glass Estimator
description:
Type: Full-Time, Remote (LATAM)

Working Hours: Mondays - Fridays, 9:00am - 5:00pm CST

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Compensation: USD $1,500 - $2,500/month (depending on seniority)



About the Company

Our client is a highly respected, family-owned glass and glazing company based in New Orleans, Louisiana, with deep industry roots dating back to 1956. Specializing in large-scale institutional, healthcare, and commercial projects, they are a regional leader in hurricane impact-rated glass systems. Operating with a lean, close-knit team, the company values mentorship, knowledge-sharing, and collaboration, and is looking for a dedicated estimator to support their next chapter of business growth.



Job Description

We are seeking an analytical and detail-oriented Remote Estimator to join a seasoned pre-construction team. In this role, you will work closely with senior leadership to augment their bidding capacity, independently owning the estimating process for mid-sized projects ($150K–$500K) while providing vital support on large-scale institutional bids exceeding $2M–$5M+. This is an incredible opportunity for a professional looking to leverage their technical expertise within a stable, supportive U.S. construction framework that values continuous learning and long-term career growth.



Responsibilities

 - Prepare highly detailed quantity takeoffs and accurate cost estimates specifically for commercial glass, glazing, and storefront systems.

 - Manage end-to-end bid documentation workflows, ensuring all bid preparation requirements and local guidelines are meticulously met.

 - Calculate accurate labor cost projections, project timelines, and logistical variables, including specialized assessments for high-rise work requiring swing stages and lifts.

 - Lead vendor outreach and request for quotes (RFQs), building and maintaining strong coordination with major U.S. suppliers like YKK, US Aluminum/CR Lawrence, and Old Castle Building Envelope.

 - Support pre-construction logistics, compile submittals, and manage RFIs to ensure a seamless handoff to operations teams.

 - Utilize Bloom & Beam OST software (or similar estimating platforms) to maintain organized, data-driven pipelines.



Project Types

 - Large institutional and healthcare facilities

 - Commercial office buildings and high-rise developments

 - Hurricane impact-rated glass and resilient building systems

 - Complex mid-to-large-scale storefront and curtain wall installations ($150K to $5M+ scope)



Requirements

 - Experience & Background: 2+ years of dedicated glass and glazing estimating experience on U.S. construction projects, OR a strong background in Civil Engineering with transferable structural estimating skills.

 - Software Proficiency: Hands-on experience with estimating software—Bloom & Beam OST is highly preferred, but equivalent takeoff platforms are accepted.

 - Technical Knowledge: Strong ability to read and interpret complex architectural and structural plans, evaluate labor dynamics, and handle multi-million-dollar bids.

 - Communication & Alignment: Exceptional, fluent English communication skills (written and verbal) for accurate internal collaboration and vendor outreach.

 - Schedule: Full-time availability strictly matching U.S. Central Time (CT) operations.

 - Market Exposure: Prior experience with hurricane-resilient building systems or projects in the Gulf Coast, Caribbean, or Puerto Rico markets is a massive plus.

title: E-commerce Procurement Specialist (Optical)
description:
Job Title: Frame Purchasing Specialist/Procurement Associate

Job Type: Full-time, Remote

Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM US Eastern Time

Salary: $800 - $1,400 USD/month (based on experience)

Location: Philippines or LATAM



About the Company

Our client is a rapidly growing U.S.-based e-commerce eyewear company specializing in designer frames, prescription lenses, and premium optical products. Combining a strong customer-first approach with streamlined online operations, the company delivers high-quality eyewear solutions to customers across the United States and internationally. As the business continues to scale, they are expanding their operations team to support increasing order volumes and enhance the customer experience.



About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Optical Purchasing Specialist to manage the purchasing and fulfillment of eyewear products, including both frames and prescription lenses, for customer orders.



This role sits at the center of the order fulfillment process and is responsible for ensuring customer orders move smoothly from purchase to production by coordinating with vendors, tracking inventory availability, and managing back orders.



The role will initially focus heavily on frame purchasing and vendor coordination, with responsibilities expanding to include prescription lens ordering and procurement as the individual becomes proficient in the role and gains familiarity with the company's optical workflows.



Success in this position requires exceptional attention to detail, strong follow-through, and the ability to proactively solve issues when products are unavailable or vendor requirements create exceptions.



Frame purchasing activities are expected to account for approximately 60–70% of the workload initially, with lens procurement responsibilities gradually increasing over time. The role will also have opportunities to cross-train in RX customer service functions to provide additional flexibility and support as the company continues to scale.




Key Responsibilities

Optical Purchasing & Order Processing

 - Review incoming customer orders in Shopify and verify frame and prescription order details.

 - Place frame orders through vendor portals accurately and promptly.

 - Enter customer information and order details into vendor systems as required.

 - Ensure all orders comply with vendor-specific purchasing requirements and procedures.

 - Learn and eventually manage prescription lens ordering processes and vendor requirements.

 - Coordinate frame and lens procurement to ensure orders progress efficiently through production.

Vendor Coordination & Procurement

 - Communicate directly with frame and lens vendors regarding product availability, lead times, and order status.

 - Monitor vendor inventory and identify potential fulfillment issues before they impact customer orders.

 - Follow up on back orders and delayed shipments to ensure timely fulfillment.

 - Build strong working relationships with vendors to improve communication and resolution times.

Inventory & Exception Management

 - Manage situations where ordered frames or lenses are unavailable, discontinued, or back ordered.

 - Research alternative solutions and coordinate internally on replacement options when necessary.

 - Understand and manage vendor purchasing rules, including minimum order quantities and bulk purchasing requirements.

 - Maintain accurate records of vendor information, order history, and purchasing activity.

Cross-Functional Support

 - Coordinate with the RX customer service team regarding order updates and fulfillment timelines.

 - Cross-train in RX customer service processes to provide operational flexibility and support during periods of high demand.

 - Assist with additional operations and fulfillment tasks as needed.



Required Qualifications

 - 2+ years of experience in the optical/eyewear industry.

 - Experience with frame ordering, optical order processing, procurement, or vendor coordination.

 - Experience using Shopify or similar e-commerce platforms.

 - Experience with optical laboratory ordering systems or vendor portals.

 - Previous experience ordering ophthalmic lenses or managing RX lens workflows.

 - Experience working with inventory management systems.

 - Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

 - Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

 - Ability to manage multiple orders, vendors, and priorities simultaneously.

 - Comfortable communicating with vendors via phone, email, and vendor portals.

 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to navigate exceptions independently.

 - Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.

We're a US-based investment firm running two brands — an SEC-regulated real-estate investment fund and a family-focused legacy coaching and publishing brand. The Traffic and Compliance Manager is the keeper of time and project tracking. We can’t afford to delay deliverables, we need help with scheduling tasks and keeping track of where the projects are in the lifecycle. And with a remote team, everyone has to remain accountable for the commitments they make of their time and turnaround of the project or process.

Success is measured two ways: every day and priority keeps moving with no wasted days, the distributed marketing team is held accountable for its hours, and every published asset is correct, on-brand, and compliant.

 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the status system and traffic flow. Own the Dailies/status tracker so every project stays visible and moving; route briefs, assets, and approvals between the EVP, the pod, and vendors; attend Manager meetings (or review the AI notes) to log tasks and commitments; set daily and weekly priorities and protect deadlines before they slip; maintain and refine the approval, routing, and publish workflows. Be the watchdog, the eagle eye, the person “in the know”.

 - Be the second set of eyes — nothing ships with an error. Receive a test ofevery email and SMS end-to-end (links, tags, opt-outs, routing, real user experience); verify UTMs on every link, email, and ad against the taxonomy before launch; proof spelling, grammar, check links and documents they link to, and functionality on everything; QA every form (it submits, tags correctly, assigns territory, notifies the right rep, lets leads book); review and approve staging builds before go-live. Ask: Is this the right user experience for this audience? Is it done with excellence?

 - Steward the regulatory approval chain. Ensure fund communication artifacts are reviewed by legal and the right parties are copied; monitor and flag new disclosure language; secure principal sign-offs on brand claims; enforce the initial creative gate so nothing advances without the EVP's sign-off (strict the first four months); steward each piece through the full chain — writer → principals → reviewer → board — and chase every handoff; route approved creative to SMEs, reviewer, and board, logging each approval; keep the approval record for every published asset; maintain one canonical, version-proofed source of truth so nothing ever pulls an outdated or non-compliant statement from the offering documents. You have authority to manage this system and process with whatever tools would work best, however, get input from others who have to use the system.

 - Own the last mile — publish and version control. Push approved assets live in the publishing stack (Notable, Planable, HubSpot, or equivalent); enforce version control so the current version is live and older ones are archived; oversee who has access to branded assets.

 - Hold the cadence and the team accountable. Keep the distributed (LatAm) marketing team accountable for hours and output–run the timesheets and process; make sure no-shows and unqualified leads actually get worked; run event pre-flight (display, QR codes/UTMs, NFC, capture forms, table materials); shadow key calls and capture action items; keep lists trimmed with Growth; assemble the weekly stats for the Monday call; reconcile the editorial and traffic calendars; identify stalls and blockers early.

title: Mid-Market Implementation Specialist - Americas (West)
description:
MID-MARKET IMPLEMENTATION SPECIALIST

Hi, I’m Daryl and I’m the Manager of Mid-Market Implementations at Ashby. One of my favorite aspects of Ashby is our operating principle of Continuous Improvement https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/culture/ashbys-operating-principles#8---implement-continuous-improvement. Coupled with our principle of caring deeply about our customers, we often find ourselves wondering, “What is a better way to accomplish this?”. That’s why I am thrilled to be hiring a Mid-Market Implementation Specialist, specifically in the PST or MST timezone! 

As a member of the Mid-Market Implementation team and part of our growing Professional Services team within Ashby’s Customer Success organization, you’ll have a unique opportunity to help shape this new implementation offering and uplevel the overall customer experience.




ABOUT THIS ROLE:

As an Implementation Specialist aligned to our Mid-Market segment, you will be responsible for managing and executing the end-to-end implementation of Ashby’s solution for Mid-Market and smaller enterprise customers. Your book of business will include about 15 active implementations at a time, each lasting 4-8 weeks. You will work directly with customers to develop and execute implementation plans that ensure a positive customer experience and expedited time to value. Your goal is to support our customers, helping them get up and running swiftly with Ashby so they can achieve their desired outcomes.




ROLE REQUIREMENTS:

 - Implementation & Project Management: You have extensive experience leading implementation and onboarding projects in high growth B2B SaaS environments, defining scope, aligning stakeholders, communicating project plans, and delivering results against agreed upon expectations. You keep teams on track to meet milestones, work effectively in a remote first setting, and are willing to travel <10% for customer engagements.

 - Technical Proficiency: You have experience with complex, multi-module SaaS systems, understand shared configuration and data models, and are comfortable with analytics, conditional logic, and relational data (Ashby knowledge is a plus but not required)

 - Customer Centricity: You deeply understand customer needs and tailor implementations to meet their specific requirements. You build strong customer relationships by maintaining high levels of engagement and communication; you’re the customer’s proactive guide and advocate throughout the implementation period.

 - Change Management: You are experienced in navigating change management processes and helping customers adapt to new systems and a refreshed approach.

 - Best Practices & Recommendations: You take pride in advising customers on best practices specific to their usage of software to ensure optimal value.

 - Critical Thinking & Solutions Orientation: You proactively address thematic customer opportunities and improve our processes accordingly. You don’t rely on ‘I’ve seen this done,’ but instead think critically to solve problems.

 - Cross-functional Collaboration: You effectively partner with cross-functional stakeholders across Customer Success, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Operations to align and define progress.
   
   

You could be a great fit if:

 - 📣 You demonstrate clear communication. You ask clarifying questions with precision and can distill complex concepts into simple themes.

 - 🎧 You are a great listener. You see your role as the voice of the customer to internal stakeholders so we can ensure that our offerings continue to evolve in accordance with customer needs.

 - 📈 You are a problem solver. You thrive at solving complex challenges with innovative, scalable solutions.

 - ⚡️You know process matters. You are eager to improve processes and workflows to enhance efficiency and efficacy.

 - 🔍 Your peers describe you as detail-oriented and technically proficient. You take pride in internal operations.

 - 📊 You are data-driven. You use metrics and analytics to inform decisions and measure success.

 - 🌍 You are adaptable. You can navigate changes in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

 - 🧑‍🏫 You love to coach. You see every teaching moment as an opportunity and are excited to help our customers grow.
   
   

You might not be a great fit if:

 - You bring project management expertise, but rely on other resources to be technical or product subject matter experts during implementations.

 - You prefer managing shorter implementations of less than 30 days.

 - You typically manage only a few simultaneous implementations at a time - This segment moves with urgency and we balance a book of business of about 15 implementations at a time

 - You are accustomed to defining ideas and strategies, yet not responsible for their execution.

 - You prefer working with a simple product (such as a point solution).

 - You prefer exclusively to build (rather than build, iterate, optimize).
   
   


OUR PHILOSOPHY

Here are a few key points (relevant to the go-to-market side) that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

 - We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is a lot easier to sell.

 - We want to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.

 - We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people (and the right work environment) deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount. We hire and compensate accordingly.



We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Operating Principles https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/culture/ashbys-operating-principles to get a sense of what we are looking for in folks on the team.

title: Commercial Counsel
description:
About the Job:

👋 I’m Kelly https://www.linkedin.com/in/kelly-fish-52116924/, Senior Legal Counsel at Ashby. I joined Ashby recently as our first dedicated legal hire and I’m now building the legal team to support our next phase of growth.

After 12 years building and scaling in-house legal teams, I was drawn to Ashby for its ambition, product vision, and the exceptional talent across the company. Working alongside smart, low-ego, high-ownership operators every day is energizing and inspires you to bring your best ideas forward. The leadership team is decisive and thoughtful, making intentional choices that balance speed, customer focus, and long-term growth.

This is our first commercial counsel hire, and depending on the caliber of the candidates we meet, we may bring on more than one. You would join as a founding member of the commercial arm of our legal team at an exciting inflection point: revenue is outpacing plan, deal volume and size are growing, and our global footprint is expanding, bringing more sophisticated enterprise customers, new regulations, and deeper cross-functional complexity.

The role is hands-on and execution-focused, primarily focused on sales commercial contracting, with a meaningful procurement blend. At the core of this opportunity is building best-in-class, in-house support for our sales contracting and the foundations that let it scale as we grow. You will be in commercial contracts every day, partnering closely with Sales to close deals and drive revenue, while building the scalable processes and playbooks that unblock commercial negotiations and focus on operational efficiency.

Commercial contracting is the heart of this role and where we need your focus and passion to ramp quickly and make the impact needed. For someone who excels at that core, and as our bandwidth and reach grow, there will be room to get involved in broader initiatives across the legal function and cross-functionally, based on where you show genuine passion and aptitude.

Strong candidates will bring demonstrable commercial contracting experience with a heavy focus on sales and GTM, and be equally comfortable in vendor and procurement work. You have succeeded in a lean, scaling legal team, and you pair sound judgment and business acumen with the ownership and soft skills to proactively bring ideas and drive solutions through to implementation. You earn trust through responsiveness, clarity, and pragmatism, advocate firmly and thoughtfully with customers and internal stakeholders alike, and protect key risk positions while keeping negotiations constructive. If you are energized by growth, low-ego, excited to work alongside exceptional talent, and motivated by the chance to shape and scale a high-impact commercial function from the ground up, I would love to meet you.



Responsibilities

 - Be the go-to reviewer for all things commercial contracting, with a primary focus on sales and a strong secondary focus on procurement, plus other opportunities such as partnerships and cross-functional work.

 - On the sales side, be an early, high-impact part of establishing full suite in-house sales support.

 - Review, draft, and negotiate customer NDAs, MSAs, Order Forms, and DPAs with a focus on speed, commercial pragmatism, and scalability.

 - Develop best-in-class sales enablement, internal guidance, and external collateral.

 - Build efficient processes and smart workflows that make commercial contracting scalable, including playbooks, cross-functional enablement, and new SOPs and workflows across a wide variety of repeatable tasks, partnering with our Legal Ops Manager where appropriate.

 - Be a responsive, reliable partner to the sales team and other internal stakeholders, someone they want to work with, not around.

 - On the procurement side, manage a steady flow and wide variety of procurement and vendor requests, reviewing and negotiating contracts in partnership with business owners to keep marketing, events, and tooling moving quickly and to meet turnaround expectations, while iterating on our procurement process as we grow.

 - Partner closely with security, IT, and product to ensure prospect and customer questionnaires are answered accurately and promptly, and to build scalable solutions.

 - Help shape and improve legal operations, including the workflows, technology, and tools relevant to contract work such as CLM and CPQ. You should be excited about what AI and new tools bring to the practice of law, with proven experience driving adoption internally.

 - Identify and get involved in other areas as our legal team's bandwidth grows, bringing clarity, insight, and an ownership mentality to everything you touch.

 - Exercise solid judgment and business acumen, including knowing how to balance ownership with flagging issues and escalating appropriately, and knowing when to pull me in.

Qualifications

 - JD from an accredited law school and active license to practice law in the US (or equivalent qualification in a relevant jurisdiction).

 - 6-8 years of legal experience,with at least 4 years in-house experience at a start-up or a company going through a significant period of growth, ideally as an early hire.

 - Experience at a Saas or high-growth tech company, familiar with SaaS business models and SaaS contract terms.

 - Demonstrable experience in commercial contract negotiation (customer-side and vendor-side) contributing directly to strong growth.

 - Excellent interpersonal skills; you genuinely enjoy working with sales teams and and other cross-function partners, and are adept at build trusted relationships.

 - Good judgment and ability to balance legal risk with business objectives.

 - Exceptional written communication: able to explain legal concepts, net-new processes, and internal communications in plain, precise language and develop playbooks and GTM-facing enablement materials. We hold a high bar for written communication across the company, and expect legal to set the example for precise, thoughtful writing, including on strategic and net-new projects.

 - You pride yourself on being organized and able to manage multiple deals and priorities simultaneously, keeping the transactional day-to-day turning while carving out time for builder projects.

Bonus:

 - Experience collaborating with a legal operations function. This role offers a rare opportunity to partner, early in the team's growth, with an accomplished Legal Ops Manager on process and tooling.

 - Exposure and strong familiarity with AI regulations and with privacy and data protection frameworks (DPAs, GDPR, CCPA).

 - Experience building or scaling contract operations, including implementing legal tech tools.

You should apply if:

 - You come in with energy and a can-do attitude, you know what it takes to succeed in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, and you have the hard and soft skills to ramp and add value quickly.

 - You love working with sales and thrive as a cross-functional partner rather than a gatekeeper, building trusted relationships with GTM leadership and across our teams and 4,500+ customers.

 - You are a solutions-oriented closer: you pair commercial, clear advice with strong operational follow-through, and you ruthlessly prioritize and drive improvements to completion.

 - You're excited to build the commercial function's foundations as an early hire, comfortable with ambiguity and eager to shape the processes we're still creating on a small but high-impact team.

 - You bring a low-ego, low-drama, high-ownership approach and welcome regular feedback.

 - You know how to hold the line, pushing back on customers and internal stakeholders professionally while keeping the relationship positive.

 - You're energized by what AI and new tools can do for legal workflows, and you've put them into practice before.

Why you shouldn’t apply:

 - You do your best work in large, established teams with mature playbooks and processes already in place. Much of this role is 0-to-1: we're building those now and need someone who brings ideas and helps shape them, not someone who waits to be told what to do.

 - You lean heavily on meetings or calls to move work forward. We're async-first with a high bar for written communication, so much of your work, decisions, and influence will happen in writing.

 - You're uncomfortable with change or regular feedback. Thriving amid change, accepting feedback as a way to be even more exceptional, and bringing a positive, low-ego, low-drama attitude are key here.

 - You find frequent internal outreach or shifting daily priorities frustrating. This role sits at the center of deal flow where context switching is part of the job.

 - You prefer to advise and manage rather than execute. This role requires doing the day-to-day work as well as building and strategizing.

 - You are hesitant about using technology to introduce speed, innovation, and efficiency into legal processes.

 - You prefer an in-office environment. This is a remote role best suited to self-starters.

About Ashby

We're building the next generation of enterprise software and we're starting with a suite of products that empower talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers to be a driving force for revenue & efficiency via a holistic, data-centric talent strategy.

We are backed by great investors, including Alkeon, Lachy Groom, Y Combinator and Elad Gil. We have over 4,500+ amazing customers including Snowflake, OpenAI, Shopify, Ramp, Notion, and Zapier (and many others who we cannot name!) and the Ashby team has 350+ people globally.

Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, very high product velocity and many years of runway. We'll share more details once we meet, but you now probably have a good idea as to why we're hiring for this role 😅.



Interview Process

Our interview process is thorough - we assess if you are the right fit for Ashby and we will provide ample information for you to determine if Ashby is the right place for you. The process for this role is as follows:

 - Recruiter Screen with Michelle - 30min

 - Hiring Manager Interview with our Ashby's Senior Legal Counsel, Kelly - 45min

 - Practical Assessment

 - Final Round - 2 to 2.5 hours of 30 minute interviews with cross-functional partners

Benefits:

 - Competitive salary and equity.

 - 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

 - Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅.

 - Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

 - Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

 - $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

 - If you’re in the US, top-notch health insurance for you and your dependents with all premiums covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

title: Content Lead, Startups
description:
Hi, I’m Anum https://www.linkedin.com/in/anumhussain/, and I’ve led the Content team here at Ashby for the past three years. Since I started this function at Ashby, I've been very intentional about how we grow with big plans for the years to come. From day one, we have built high trust internally to avoid becoming a service desk for content needs and instead operating as a strategic lever that thinks critically about our audience’s needs and delivers on it consistently.

Historically, our reliance has been on data storytelling, in-person courses, our highly listened to podcast, and Ashby One conferences. By nature, a lot of this content is well suited for scaling organizations. Now, I want to take a step back and breathe life back into our blog, which we have somewhat neglected, by thinking critically about one of our most important audiences at Ashby: Our startup talent leaders and hiring-focused founders. It’s important to note these are distinct personas, though with plenty of audience overlap. It’ll be important to partner with our Startup Partnerships team in understanding the definitions and nuances of these groups.

This audience is in need of clear hiring playbooks, recruiting resources, and a lot of the foundational content that is ripe for traditional SEO. Though I'm sure it'll come as no surprise that the big bet we need to make here is more on AEO.

To be clear, this role isn't about churning out empty listicle content, though it does require output velocity that matches the pace at which the startup audience is moving. We'll be thinking critically about how to create high-quality pieces that don’t sacrifice the Ashby voice, tone, or approach in order to meet an algorithmic change. We'll also think critically about where our audience lives and breathes. This means owning X.com http://X.com, which may sound a bit non-traditional to a content role, but the way we think about social media is very intentional. Different members of the team own different aspects of social to ensure our content meets the right audience in the right place and format.

You'll also collaborate with our partnerships team, who run strategic activation for our VC talent community, to ensure that we have the right resources for their suite of programming. There'll be more that we need to carve out and deliver over time. For now, I'm looking for someone who cares deeply about the startup community, has a deep passion for writing regularly, and who is eager to explore how to create quality content that meets AEO without sacrificing on brand reputation.




WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR IN THIS ROLE

Develop a startup recruiting blog. You'll be the first true owner of a blog strategy at Ashby. We've historically leaned on data reports, courses, and events to carry our content, so this is a genuine 0 to 1 opportunity to define what our blog stands for and how it earns a place in the startup hiring conversation.

Publish that blog consistently. Your inputs will come from SEO and AEO research, customer intel pulled from customer calls, our partnerships team, and anyone across go-to-market who has built a strong understanding of the startup audience. You'll turn all of that into a steady drumbeat of writing that holds our quality bar.

Build a real publishing strategy for X.com http://X.com. This isn't about promoting content that already exists elsewhere. It's about thinking critically on how we speak to startup talent leaders and founders on the channel they live on most, in a voice built for that channel (not just a repost of the blog).

Collaborate with our Partnerships team. They run strategic activation for our VC talent community, and you'll make sure the content and resources that show up in their in-person activations and engagement campaigns are sharp, clear, and genuinely useful to the founders and talent leaders in the room.

Own the audience, not just a content type. Whether it's a blog post or a post on X, you're thinking end to end about what a startup talent leader or hiring-focused founder needs next, and building the content ecosystem around them accordingly.




YOU WILL PROBABLY LOVE THIS ROLE IF

 - You care deeply about the startup community and want your work to genuinely help talent leaders and founders hire better.

 - You have a real passion for writing daily. This role will keep you close to the page versus managing others' writing from a distance.

 - You're excited by the challenge of AEO and want to earn visibility in LLM-powered search without writing to a checklist or sacrificing brand voice to chase an algorithm.

 - You think in terms of owning an audience rather than owning a content type. You're just as comfortable figuring out what a startup founder needs to hear on X as you are shaping a blog post that ranks.

 - You're energized by 0 to 1 work. Ashby hasn't had a true blog owner before, so you'll be defining what great looks like from first principles.

 - You're comfortable being resourceful with inputs, pulling customer intel, SEO data, and partner context together into something that reads like Ashby, not a patchwork of everyone else's priorities.


THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

 - You only write to what the SEO recommendations tell you. This role is about creative judgment first, with SEO and AEO as inputs, not the whole brief.

 - You struggle with the idea of owning an audience versus owning a content type. If you'd rather just be "the blog writer" or "the social writer" without connecting the two around the same reader, this won't be the right fit.

 - You want a fully built playbook to execute against. Much of this role is building the blog strategy and the X.com http://X.com approach from scratch.

 - You're not interested in the operational reality of regular publishing. This is a high-output role for someone who genuinely enjoys writing that often.

 - You'd rather work at a distance from customers. You'll need to be close to customer calls, the partnerships team, and the broader startup community to know what's actually worth writing about.

Hi! I'm Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. 👋 As our Support organization scales globally, one of the most critical levers for delivering an exceptional customer experience is making sure we have the right capacity, in the right places, at the right times, without sacrificing flexibility, quality, or humanity.

We recently hired our first Workforce Management Lead to build the forecasting and capacity-planning foundation for the team. Now we're adding a Real Time Analyst to own the execution layer: turning those forecasts into thoughtful schedules and managing coverage in real time as the day unfolds.

This is not a traditional call-center WFM role. Our Support team is highly tenured, deeply technical, and made up of thoughtful practitioners who regularly contribute beyond tickets, partnering on projects, enabling self-service, shaping tooling, and influencing product direction. Your job is to keep coverage healthy and SLAs met while protecting the flexibility that lets this team do its best work. You'll treat real-time management as an enabling function, not an adherence-policing exercise.

This role is for someone who loves the craft of scheduling and the fast pace of intraday management, is energized by live problem-solving, and sees patterns in real-time data that make the whole operation run smoother.



About This Role

As the Real Time Analyst, you'll own scheduling and real-time analysis (RTA) for a global Support organization. You'll partner closely with our WFM Lead, who owns long-range forecasting and capacity strategy, and translate those plans into practical schedules and live coverage decisions. Day-to-day, you'll monitor how the team is tracking against plan, recommend and make real-time adjustments, and surface the intraday signals that keep us ahead of SLA risk.

Because our WFM function is still young, you'll have significant influence over how scheduling and RTA operate at Ashby, setting up scalable, humane practices rather than inheriting rigid ones.




ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES


SCHEDULING AND COVERAGE DESIGN

 - Build and maintain global schedules that align required coverage with our headcount, skills, and time zones, translating the WFM Lead's capacity plans into workable day-to-day schedules.

 - Partner with Support Managers to evolve schedules as the team grows, regions expand, and needs change, including managing shift-change and time-off workflows.

 - Design coverage that supports SLA attainment while preserving the flexibility and autonomy our team values.

 - Account for skill distribution and routing so the right work reaches the right people.

Real-Time Analysis and Intraday Management

 - Monitor queues and team activity in real time, tracking how we're pacing against schedule and SLA throughout the day.

 - Make and recommend live adjustments (re-prioritization, coverage shifts, breaks/offline time) to keep service levels healthy as volume and complexity fluctuate.

 - Spot intraday risks early and communicate them clearly, coordinating with Support Managers to respond without creating unnecessary alarm.

 - Manage real-time exceptions (spikes, outages, unplanned absences) with sound judgment and a calm, collaborative approach.

Data and Insights

 - Track team data and behaviors as inputs that improve planning, not as compliance metrics to enforce.

 - Build and maintain dashboards that give visibility into coverage health, intraday trends, and emerging risk.

 - Feed real-world scheduling and RTA learnings back to the WFM Lead to sharpen forecasts and capacity assumptions over time.

Cross-Functional Partnership

 - Partner closely with the WFM Lead, Support Managers, and Support Operations to keep coverage plans aligned with reality.

 - Act as a trusted, day-to-day point of contact for coverage questions and live adjustments.

 - Advocate for sustainable, human-centered scheduling decisions that scale with the business.




ROLE REQUIREMENTS

Scheduling and Real-Time Management Expertise

 - Hands-on experience with scheduling and/or real-time/intraday management in a Support, CX, or technical services environment (e.g., WFM Analyst, RTA Analyst, or Scheduling Analyst).

 - Strong grasp of coverage strategies, adherence/shrinkage/occupancy/conformance concepts, and how they translate into daily service levels.

 - Comfort making sound real-time decisions with imperfect information and a fast clock.

Systems and Analytical Thinking

 - Highly analytical, able to read live data quickly and turn it into clear, actionable adjustments and recommendations.

 - Experience with WFM/scheduling tooling and comfort building or maintaining dashboards.

 - Familiarity working with Support metrics and SLAs in a nuanced, non-mechanical way.

Collaborative and People-Centered

 - Deep respect for the expertise of Support professionals and an appreciation for flexible, trust-based environments.

 - Strong communicator who can flag risk and coordinate live adjustments without reading as "policing."

 - Comfortable partnering across managers and levels, and taking direction from the WFM Lead on strategy while owning the execution.



You Should Apply If:

 - You love the craft of scheduling and the pace of real-time coverage management.

 - You see WFM as an enabling function, not a policing one.

 - You're energized by live problem-solving and making quick, well-reasoned calls under pressure.

 - You're excited to partner with experienced, technical Support professionals who value autonomy and impact.

 - You want to help shape how scheduling and RTA operate as Support scales, while partnering with a WFM Lead who owns the forecasting foundation.



You May Not Want to Apply If:

 - You're looking for a traditional Support environment focused primarily on adherence enforcement.

 - You want to own long-range forecasting and capacity strategy end-to-end (that sits with our WFM Lead; this role is the scheduling + RTA partner to it).

 - You prefer fixed rules and static models over iteration, flexibility, and real-time judgment.

 - You're uncomfortable operating in ambiguity or building structure where none yet exists.

 - You believe there's one "correct" way to staff or schedule Support.




ABOUT ASHBY

We’re building the next generation of enterprise software, and we’re starting with a suite of products that help talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. Learn more on our website:  https://ashbyhq.comhttps://www.ashbyhq.com/

We are well-funded and backed by great investors, including Y Combinator, Elad Gil and Lachy Groom. We publicly launched in October 2022 and are working with amazing companies we're proud to partner with.

We’ve built an incredible team and exceptional product over the past few years, and we truly are just getting started. In short, this is the perfect time to join 🚀

 


ABOUT GO TO MARKET

Our Support team is a part of our Customer Success department, and thus is a part of our Go To Market function. Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

 - We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products, since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell.

 - We also spend a lot of time building a best-in-class customer experience. We aim to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers (we hope our 9.8 Support rating on G2 signals this).

 - We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people and the right work environment deliver much high performance and we're built accordingly.


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our interview process is thorough — we aim to ensure each person that joins the team is the right fit for Ashby and will provide ample information for you to assess if Ashby is the right fit for you. The process for this role is as follows:

description:

About the Role

Dandy is seeking a Senior Mechatronics Engineer to join our elite Precision Robotics R&D team. This role is the technical cornerstone for developing the mechatronic architecture of our next-generation Special Purpose Machines (SPM) for manufacturing custom-made prosthetics.

As an engineer with 6+ years of experience, you will bridge the gap between high-level robotic theory and physical execution. You will be responsible for building the "nervous system" of our machines—integrating actuators, sensors, and motion control into a cohesive, high-performance architecture. This is a hybrid role in Milpitas, where you will drive innovation from initial concept and rapid prototyping through to production-ready systems.

 

What You’ll Do

 - System Architecture & Design: Architect and integrate complex robotic hardware systems, including precision actuators, sensors, and electromechanical subsystems, ensuring they meet the micron-level reliability required for manufacturing custom-made prosthetics.

 - Special Purpose Machine Design Expertise: Apply deep technical knowledge of both additive (3D printing) and subtractive (milling, grinding, polishing) processes to design versatile, high-precision manufacturing platforms.

 - High-Fidelity Prototyping: Lead the rapid prototyping of components and conduct rigorous structural/thermal analyses. Validate designs through intensive performance testing and failure-mode analysis (FMEA).

 - Cross-Functional Integration: Act as the primary technical interface between mechanical, electrical, firmware, and software teams to ensure seamless system integration and optimization of system dynamics.

 

What We’re Looking For

 - Experience: 6+ years of machine-building experience, specifically in hardware, mechatronics, or robotics engineering with a focus on system-level architecture for production systems.

 - Education: B.S./M.S. or Ph.D. in Mechatronics, Mechanical, Electrical, or Robotics Engineering.

 - Founding Mindset: Proven ability to work as an individual contributor in an early-stage environment while possessing the leadership skills to scale a team.

 - Technical Mastery: * Expert-level proficiency with Solidworks or similar platforms and a deep understanding of varied fabrication and manufacturing processes.
   
   - Profound knowledge of robotic kinematics/dynamics, motor controllers, and simulation tools
   
   - Hands-on experience with sensor integration, embedded systems, and manufacturing design execution.

 - Soft Skills: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to mentor junior engineers and manage multiple projects in a high-velocity high growth environment.

 - Ability to self-direct, self-managing issues to closure involving all necessary teams, and adapt quickly to program changes.

 - Willingness to travel to suppliers, manufacturing, and testing facilities as required throughout product development (~20% travel)

 

Bonus Points For

 - Experience working as a System or Mechanical Engineer for an Automation System Integrator or OEM, with a track record of delivering turnkey automated solutions.

 - Advanced Motion Control: Knowledge of waveform tuning, custom PLC programming (Beckhoff/TwinCAT), or experience with high-performance motion controllers (ACS, Elmo, Others).

 - Experience with laser interferometry, high-resolution optical encoders, and sub-micron calibration techniques for milling and printing paths.

 - Expertise in integrating Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) and 3D vision systems into robotic workflows for real-time quality feedback.

 - Advanced capability in FEA/CFD for thermal and vibration analysis of high-speed robotic linkages and spindles.

 - Experience with the design or qualification of custom brushless motors, linear actuators, or robotic end-effectors.

 - Robotic Safety: Knowledge of ISO 10218 or ISO 13482 standards for robotic system safety and collaborative operation.

description:

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an Operations Finance Manager to be the finance partner to the people who run our manufacturing network. You’ll own the financial picture for our manufacturing sites and our third-party lab network, and help operators fully understand their cost structure and identify opportunities.

This is a role for someone who wants to be close to the physical business. You’ll spend real time in the details of overhead absorption, cost per unit, and vendor economics, and you’ll also be in the room when we decide whether to buy a piece of equipment, open or consolidate a site, or bring work in-house. It’s a high-ownership seat with visibility across Operations and Finance leadership.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Partner with Manufacturing Site Leads. Own the finance relationship with each site. Make sure every site lead knows their budget cold, understands what’s driving their variances, and has what they need to act on it. Be the person they call before they make a decision, not after.

 - Partner with the 3P Labs team. Bring financial clarity to the routing decisions this team owns. Build the analysis that shows what each routing choice costs us, and make sure the trade-offs are understood in real time — not discovered at close.

 - Run the operations monthly close. Lead pre-close and prelim close meetings with site leads: align with Cost Accounting in advance, set clear expectations with attendees, drive follow-ups to completion, and ensure every variance explanation is properly quantified and owned.

 - Own the accuracy of manufacturing COGS. Perform expense detail review on fixed overhead COGS to confirm costs are booked correctly. Analyze third-party lab costs to validate routing. Run gold and precious metals margin analyses to confirm we’re pricing to our markup targets.

 - Make the process better every month. This close is not in its final form. We want someone who treats each cycle as an opportunity to remove manual work, tighten timelines, and raise the quality of what comes out the other side.

 - Support strategic decisions. Build the analysis behind manufacturing equipment purchases, manufacturing footprint decisions, and insource vs. outsource evaluations — and have a point of view on the answer, not just the model.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 6+ years of finance experience, including meaningful time in a physical-product business in a high growth environment

 - Demonstrated success partnering with operators. You’ve built strong working relationships with operators and can translate between operational reality and financial impact in both directions.

 - Strong ownership of recurring processes. You’ve run a close, a forecast cycle, or a reporting cadence and left it better than you found it.

 - Excellent modeling skills - proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and also comfort w/ automating spreadsheet work with Claude Co-Work or other AI tools.  Comfortable getting into large, messy datasets.

 - Exceptional communication skills — able to distill complex analysis into a clear recommendation for an executive audience.

 - Bias for action and comfort with ambiguity. You’re willing to have backbone with senior stakeholders and push for the right answer.

Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

 - Own the field commissioning program across all MEP systems on hyperscale data center projects at 100MW+, serving as the primary on-site authority for mechanical, electrical, and controls integration.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a motivated and technically capable Controls Engineer to support the design, programming, commissioning, maintenance, and troubleshooting of building automation and control systems across our critical facility infrastructure. This is a mid-level role that blends hands-on field technician work with engineering responsibilities — making it ideal for a strong controls technician ready to grow into an engineering role, or an early-career controls engineer who wants to stay connected to the field.

You will work closely with the Central Engineering and Operations teams to keep BMS, EPMS, PLC, and equipment-level control systems running reliably in a 24/7 mission-critical data center environment — while also contributing to engineering tasks such as sequence development, commissioning support, deployments, system integration, and documentation. You are equally comfortable navigating a BMS front-end, calibrating a field sensor, or programming a PLC based on a Sequence of Operations.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on BMS/BAS controllers, field devices, sensors, actuators, and control panels while maintaining accurate as-built documentation.

 - Diagnose and resolve BMS, EPMS, and equipment-level control faults using front-end software and field test tools including multimeters, loop calibrators, and clamp meters.

 - Navigate and configure BMS platforms (Ignition, Metasys, Niagara, EcoStruxure) including point mapping, alarm configuration, setpoint adjustments, and basic graphics updates.

 - Support PLC/HMI troubleshooting, PID loop tuning, trend log analysis, and integration between BMS, EPMS, DCIM, and equipment control systems across BACnet, Modbus, and SNMP.

 - Execute commissioning activities including point-to-point verification, loop calibration, functional performance testing, and documentation for new construction and retrofit projects.

 - Ensure full compliance with NFPA 70E electrical safety standards, site LOTO procedures, and formal change management processes including MOPs and CMMS documentation.




BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering Technology, Controls Engineering, Building Automation, or related field — OR equivalent vocational training and directly relevant experience.

 - Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience in building automation, controls, or instrumentation in a commercial, industrial, or mission-critical facility environment.

 - Working knowledge of at least one major BMS/BAS platform (Ignition preferred, Schneider EcoStruxure, Metasys, Niagara, or equivalent) and control system communication protocols including BACnet IP/MSTP and Modbus TCP/RTU.

 - Ability to read and interpret control drawings, wiring schematics, P&IDs, one-line diagrams, and equipment data sheets; proficiency with standard field test and calibration tools.

 - Familiarity with HVAC Sequences of Operations concepts, NEC wiring requirements, and NFPA 70E electrical safety and LOTO/LOTOTO procedures.

 - Strong attention to detail, solid documentation habits, and ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
   


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience working in a data center, colocation facility, or other Tier III/IV mission-critical environment.

THE NETWORK TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Network the control plane that keeps gigawatts safe. BMS, EPMS, and SCADA traffic ride the networks you build, and at this scale a dropped control packet is a facility incident, not a retry.

 - One controls architecture, stamped across every site. A standardized, segmented controls network deployed at every new build, integrated with landlord and partner OT domains without inheriting their risk.

 - Make oversubscription safe at machine speed. Our sites run more IT nameplate than utility capacity, managed by a metering-to-load-shed control loop that must respond in seconds across the network you own.
   


ROLE SCOPE

 - Own the controls network layer for BMS, EPMS, and SCADA across all sites: a standardized architecture of firewalls and border leaf/spine, a dedicated BMS spine in the MDF, IDFs placed within copper reach of field devices, and MACSec-capable L3 switching for every IP endpoint.

 - Build the telemetry and command paths for our Ignition SCADA platform (redundant per-MDF server stacks, 1-second sampling), including the demand-management loop where electrical metering detects overload, SCADA decides, and load-shed and shutdown paths execute in seconds so sites safely run more IT nameplate than utility capacity.

 - Engineer failure modes deliberately so equipment islands gracefully on comms loss and every degraded state of the network is known and bounded before it happens.

 - Integrate with landlord-owned and partner-owned OT domains at colocation sites through firewalled boundaries, replicating historian data across a controlled edge without flattening security domains.

 - Enforce the OT security posture: Palo Alto-class firewalled OT edges, OT-aware monitoring, and strict segmentation between production, controls, and enterprise networks.

 - Embed the controls network in site design from day one, working with facility engineers, controls and commissioning engineers, MEP designers, and security so the network is commissioned with the building.

 - Ability to travel up to 25% of the time to our Data Centers and construction sites
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You've designed and operated OT/ICS networks (BMS, EPMS, SCADA) in production facilities where a control outage had physical consequences.

 - Familiarity with industrial din-rail mount switch types. They will pop up here and there (esp on OTS equipment), good to know how to wrangle them.

 - You work in BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, and OPC UA daily and know their failure modes on a real network, along with the IT layers underneath: routing, multicast where needed, QoS, and PTP or NTP time distribution.

 - You've built segmented industrial architectures with firewalled IT/OT boundaries and held the line against pressure to flatten domains for convenience.

 - You've sat between controls engineers and network engineers and translated both directions, turning a control sequence into VLANs, routes, and firewall rules and explaining a network constraint back in controls terms.

 - You've commissioned networks alongside building commissioning, proving control paths end to end before the facility carried load.

 - You document architectures well enough that another engineer can build the next site from your drawings without calling you.

 - Bonus: IEC 62443 or similar OT security depth. Ignition or a comparable SCADA platform. Data center MEP systems familiarity. Electrical metering and power quality systems.

 - Bonus: IEC 61850 or similar Power System communication depth. Familiar with networking electrical protection equipment (via GOOSE, GSE, etc) and trade-offs between major power system vendor hardware.
